name: com.newki.choosefile.provider.ChooseFileDocumentProvider
description: On Android 11 and newer, Newki ChooseFile uses this Provider to read the current folder and fill its file browser with files and folders. Android can also discover it as a document source, although this version gives the system browser no starting folders or file-opening result.
disableEffect: Newki ChooseFile cannot list files or folders on Android 11 and newer, so users cannot choose a file there.
